## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      14 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Aug 17, 2026 - Nov 3, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Jahi120_, Nov 2, 2026, 1/5: "The app has known bugs that they have not been able to fix, but they are still selling it. I cannot get a refund despite a non functioning app. Buyer beware"
            2. _it is the best gMe of all TIME_, Oct 29, 2026, 1/5: "The app used to be decent until they had a massive UI overhaul and update which is fine if the app still worked, constant crashes, where for months I couldn’t get past the loading screen. Then I got charged the yearly renewal which I imperially went to cancel and try to get a refund for. However despite the support page saying to contact their email they never responded and instead cancelled my pro membership instead, without first even giving the refund or ever contacting me back. Overall this app and company are horrible with a buggy mess of an app. They are many better, free alternatives. I highly recommend skipping on Opal. Just keep in mind if you ever feel like buying the subscription in a few months you may not even be able to use the app anymore."
            3. _Anatanotenshi_, Oct 15, 2026, 1/5: "Very disappointed with what the application has become. Before, it worked very well, it blocked requested applications after the requested time and unblocked them after the requested time. Now it no longer blocks. I can spend hours on an application with a 15min block without ever seeing the block. Sometimes I spend 2 minutes there and I'm blocked, and when I want to unblock my application for 15 minutes it blocks immediately without the 15 minute delay, multiple times, which means that I have to return to the page several times to unblock my application without success. Suddenly my fingers learned the automatic path to unlock time, which became useless because what prevented me from unlocking time were these movements and this extra time needed to unlock the application, and because of these bugs it became automatic. And just as unbearable, the blocking time is sometimes 3 times longer than requested for no reason. This app was great and did its job very well. Now it's just become useless scenery at best and actively distracting at worst, and it no longer serves its purpose at all. Very disappointed with what she has become."
